topic: Data access and anomaly detection methods
summary_markdown:
The conversation covered several technical topics. First, a discussion occurred regarding the licensing of DataGrip, with suggestions to check for corporate licenses through AllUnite.

Later, [me] provided a SQL query template for retrieving daily total traffic data from the `allunite.raw_lidar2d_session_buffer` table. Following this, [me] offered to run an anomaly detector script for a specified period, providing a GitHub link and noting that the current example was set for a single day.

[p1] confirmed they would adjust the date parameters in the scripts.
decisions: A SQL query template was provided for accessing raw lidar 2D session buffer data.
action_items: [me] will provide an anomaly detector script/run it for a specified period.
